_what: Which Reel format each post gets. Read by style.js (formatOf) and voice.py (format_of). Lives in social/config/ because every social/*.json is read as a week file. A post can force one with "format": "slides", "stickman", or "mascot". Promos are always slides. (1) The A/B test (Moe, 2026-10-22), start to end: value posts alternate by schedule slot between the slide Reels (A, reel.js) and the 3D stick figure Reels (B, rendered on Moe's laptop by the Content Crew into public/social/<post id>/). (2) The three format rotation (Moe, 2026-10-24), from rotation.start with no end: value posts take formats[(days since 2026-10-05 + slot) mod 3], so every day carries one of each and each format moves to another time slot each day. stickman and mascot are rendered on Moe's laptop. Before start everything is slides.
